packet.title: EXI decoder with built-in grammars
packet.summary: Decodes schema-less streams in bit-packed and byte-aligned alignment into tree builder events, with every fidelity option and the fragment option.

body.p: After 8.3. EXI 1.0, sections 5 (the header, options out of band), 6, 8.1 to 8.4 (built-in document, fragment and element grammars, with learning) and 8.3 (event codes as the fidelity options prune them).

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_grammar.c, the grammar machine both codecs run; src/exi_decoder.c, the event loop to the builder, the NS events (prefixes ns0, ns1, ... without preserves_prefixes), the limits of sxml_exi_limits.
Owns: those files, tests/exi_decoder_test.c, their part of src/exi_internal.h, sxml_exi_decoder_decode in src/exi.c.
Done when: every decode check of the sets bit-packed, bit-packed-full, byte-alignment-full, string-limits, string-limits-zero and fragment passes and is in the ratchet.
